主要内容: Royal Bank of Canada issued $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 1.600% Senior Notes, due January 21, 2025. The bank also issued $400,000,000 aggregate principal amount of Senior Floating Rate Notes, due January 21, 2025. Additionally, Royal Bank of Canada issued $500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 2.050% Senior Notes, due January 21, 2027, and $300,000,000 aggregate principal amount of Senior Floating Rate Notes, due January 21, 2027. The issuance was accompanied by legal opinions from Sullivan & Cromwell LLP and Norton Rose Fulbright Canada LLP regarding the validity and taxation of the notes. The report was signed by James Salem, Executive Vice-President and Treasurer, on January 21, 2022.
